scope: Independent source-guard review; no existing-file changes, no runner/image/cloud/native/provider/model activity.

criteria.assertion: Exact returned candidate SHA/tree and accepted fixture dependency are bound; existing source-guard edits are restricted to collector two source pins and two expected-source-pin assertions/name clarification.
Recompute the canonical 53-member current context and exact unchanged assembler bytes from candidate source; pins match both. Preserve historical constants and failure evidence.

All original negative controls remain byte-preserved except the explicitly authorized expected-source literals/name; prior manifest is rejected and altered current bytes, missing/extra/duplicate members are refused.

Source-only context flags remain SOURCE_ONLY and commitAuthority:false; source acceptance does not supply fresh review, caller authority, executable runner approval, build/spend approval, image admission or G1 runtime evidence.

Existing principal, account/region/profile, Python executable/hash and actual-owner execution closure guards remain unchanged. Windows-bound real-owner check remains a truthful unsupported-host failure or unrun check, never a skipped or weakened assertion.
Local mocked/offline guard and packaging tests verify actual admission logic without network/cloud/native executable execution; all failures and environment limits remain visible.
Review independent source mismatch counterexamples against exact freeze; no root/shared/source edits and no background processes left. Return ACCEPT_SOURCE/HOLD for source guard repair only.
